summary: {person} explains who works along a bus route that looks expendable on a system map.
realLife: Milwaukee advocates identified a concentration of employers of people with visual or hearing disabilities along threatened Route 28.
gates: A proposed change affects a route serving a documented employment cluster.
weights: Shift times with few alternative connections make the workplace account more relevant.
inGame: needs: proposed route change, workplace locations and testimony about employee travel.

turns.what: The planner tests it at shift change.
turns.pulledBy: A worker provides a usable alternative connection.
turns.writesBack: Record its travel time and accessibility.

turns.what: The worker shows the supervisor the missed connection.
turns.pulledBy: No alternative arrives before the shift.
turns.writesBack: Add the workplace trip to the service review.
